jobs.title: Product Line Program Manager - Tulsa
jobs.description:
JOB REQUIREMENTS
• Advanced understanding of project and program management processes, including scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, quality, communication, stakeholder management, and change management.
• Strong working knowledge of PLM, NPD/NPI, stage-gate governance, product release, and lifecycle decision processes.
• Working knowledge of engineering, manufacturing operations, supply chain, procurement, quality systems, regulatory requirements, service readiness, and production readiness.
• Knowledge of requirements management, Engineering Change Management, change control, configuration management, document control, and product data governance.
• Ability to manage multiple complex programs, priorities, stakeholders, dependencies, and deliverables with limited supervision.
• Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority, resolve conflict, negotiate commitments, and facilitate difficult conversations.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-level summaries, gate-review packages, presentations, dashboards, and program reports.
• Ability to identify program risks, schedule constraints, resource gaps, cost concerns, quality issues, and technical dependencies; develop mitigation plans and escalate appropriately.
• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to understand budgets, cost targets, forecasts, business cases, and value-based portfolio tradeoffs.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with PLM, ERP, project management, scheduling, document-control, requirements, or reporting systems preferred.
• Ability to interpret technical documents, drawings, specifications, requirements, bills of material, release documentation, quality records, and customer requirements.
• May require travel to customer sites, supplier locations, field locations, manufacturing facilities, industry events, or other NOV locations.
• Must maintain confidentiality and comply with all NOV safety, quality, business conduct, and HSE requirements.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field required; technical degree preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
• Typically 5 or more years of relevant experience leading complex cross-functional projects or programs in product development, NPD/NPI, engineering, manufacturing, operations, or related roles.
• Demonstrated experience leading products through structured PLM or stage-gate processes from concept through production and commercial release.
• Strong experience within manufacturing, industrial equipment, oil and gas, energy services, artificial lift, ESP, or a similar technical product environment preferred.
• Experience managing portfolios of concurrent product development programs while balancing schedule, quality, cost, resource, and business priorities.
• ESP systems experience and/or artificial lift product knowledge strongly preferred.
• PMP or comparable project/program management certification is a plus; demonstrated product development leadership is more important than certification.
BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
• Strategic Mindset
• Business Insight
• Drives Results
• Ensures Accountability
• Plans and Aligns
• Manages Complexity
• Decision Quality
• Balances Stakeholders
• Collaborates
• Communicates Effectively
• Influences
• Courage
• Builds Effective Teams
• Instills Trust
• Situational Adaptability
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
• PLM Program Management
• New Product Development / NPI
• Stage-Gate Governance and Executive Reviews
• Portfolio Prioritization and Resource Planning
• Integrated Scheduling and Milestone Management
• Risk, Issue, Decision, and Change Management
• Requirements Management and Traceability
• Engineering Change Management and Change Control
• Configuration Management and Product Release
• Manufacturing and Production Readiness
• Supply Chain, Sourcing, and Procurement Coordination
• Quality Systems and Regulatory Readiness
• Cost Management, Forecasting, and Business Case Support
• Executive Communication and Decision Facilitation
• ESP / Artificial Lift Product Knowledge
• Continuous Improvement and Time-to-Market Reduction
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex cross-functional product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from concept through commercial release and deployment.
• Drive programs through all PLM and stage-gate milestones; establish gate plans, ensure required deliverables are complete, and secure timely reviews and approvals.
• Coordinate Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Product Management, Finance, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
• Develop and manage integrated schedules, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, action registers, risk registers, issue logs, and decision records.
• Define and control program scope, requirements, budgets, cost targets, resources, quality objectives, and production-readiness criteria in alignment with business priorities.
• Proactively identify execution constraints and roadblocks; lead mitigation, recovery, and corrective-action plans and escalate decisions when needed.
• Facilitate program reviews, executive stage-gate reviews, decision meetings, and product release approvals; clearly communicate status, risks, opportunities, and required actions.
• Drive accountability and alignment across functional organizations without relying on direct authority; resolve conflicts, negotiate commitments, and hold action owners accountable.
• Coordinate requirements management, Engineering Change Management, change control, configuration management, technical documentation, and product release records.
• Coordinate supply-chain, sourcing, procurement, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, service, and operational-readiness activities to support successful production launch.
• Coordinate new product trials, customer or field deployments, feedback, lessons learned, and improvement actions in collaboration with product line and technical teams.
• Develop and maintain program dashboards, KPIs, portfolio reports, and executive summaries covering schedule, cost, quality, risk, decisions, and time-to-market.
• Manage and prioritize a portfolio of concurrent programs; identify resource conflicts and recommend sequencing, tradeoffs, or escalation based on business value and execution risk.
• Continuously improve PLM governance, stage-gate criteria, program-management tools, reporting practices, workflows, and cross-functional communication.
• Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to developing project or program management resources and cross-functional team members.
• Perform other work-related tasks as assigned and comply with all NOV Company and HSE policies and procedures.
FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES
• Support Artificial Lift product development and lifecycle activities, including ESP systems and related technologies, from opportunity definition through product release and field deployment.
• Apply ESP, artificial lift, oil and gas, or similar industrial-product knowledge to support program decisions, technical and commercial alignment, and product line priorities.
• Coordinate local and global teams to support design maturity, documentation readiness, supplier readiness, manufacturing validation, quality approval, and field introduction.
• Partner with Product Management and product line leadership to align the development portfolio with customer needs, technology roadmaps, resource capacity, and strategic growth priorities.
• Support preparation of executive presentations, gate-review materials, product updates, technical documentation, case studies, and customer-facing materials as required.
• Promote consistent PLM practices, onboarding, coaching, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer across teams supporting the Artificial Lift product portfolio.
The Product Line Program Manager is a senior program leadership role responsible for leading complex, cross-functional product development programs from concept through commercial release and deployment. This position drives execution across Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and stage-gate milestones and helps ensure products are delivered in accordance with scope, schedule, cost, quality, manufacturing readiness, and business objectives. This role partners with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Sourcing, Regulatory, Service, Product Management, Finance, and product line leadership. The Product Line Program Manager is expected to influence without direct authority, facilitate executive decisions and gate approvals, remove execution roadblocks, and continuously improve PLM governance and time-to-market. Experience with artificial lift products, ideally ESP systems or other highly engineered rotating equipment, is preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition: U.S. Customs Compliance Specialist

Position Overview: We are seeking a knowledgeable and detail-oriented U.S. Customs Compliance Specialist with expertise in policy and procedure implementation. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that our company's import activities comply with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) regulations. This role requires an ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing an openness to learn and understand new concepts and evolving frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

- Policy & Procedure Implementation: Implement NOV’s customs compliance policies & procedures across all relevant departments, ensuring adherence to regulations and minimizing the risk of non-compliance.

- Customs Entry Processing:  Oversee the timely and accurate preparation & submission of customs entries, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and requirements.

- Entry Review & Monitoring: Conduct regular post entry reviews and assessments to evaluate accuracy of our Customs brokers, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as necessary.

- Broker Management:  Manage relationships with customs brokers and other service providers, ensuring that they meet established performance standards and comply with all contractual obligations.

- Training and Education: Provide training and education to employees involved in import activities to ensure awareness of customs compliance requirements and promote a culture of compliance throughout the organization.

- Documentation Management: Oversee the maintenance of accurate and complete customs documentation, including import records, classifications, valuation, and duty calculations.

- Regulatory Compliance: Implement procedural changes in response to instructions from management regarding regulatory policy shifts.

- Collaboration: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including supply chain, legal, finance, and operations teams, to ensure alignment of customs compliance efforts with overall business objectives.

- Other:   Other duties as deemed necessary by the Customs Compliance Manager and/or Director

Qualifications:

- Minimum of 3 years of working experience, preferably in a Compliance role.

- Understanding of U.S. Customs regulations, including Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification, valuation, country of origin rules, and free trade agreements.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex customs compliance concepts to diverse audiences.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Customs Specialist) are a plus.

- Intermediate level Excel

- Experience navigating ERP and Work Management systems.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Must be willing to work flexible hours to accommodate business needs.

The Operations Supervisor will report directly to the Facility Manager. Responsibilities will include the implementation and management of the Fortress Downhole Tools Cyclops Setting Tool Recycling program, including the coordination, performance, and execution of Fortress processes and procedures. •    Available to work weekends and holidays as needed to support customer field operations
•    Excellent problem solving, interpersonal communication, and operational management skills

•    Ensures all necessary equipment and tools are available and adequately maintained to perform all aspects of the job
•    Ensure all QA/QC policies & procedures are always top priority
•    Ensure all employees are up to date with safety training and PPE
•    Coordinate tool needs between shop and upper management
•    Interviewing, hiring, and firing of Tool Assistants and Specialists
•    Train and progress shop personnel
•    Create scheduling and grading employees
•    Maintain reports on ongoing jobs and activity to Fortress management
•    Maintain adequate inventory levels
•    Oversee all technicians time sheets/days off
•    Ensure housekeeping is kept up to highest standard every day
•    Maintains the highest level of professionalism and works with honesty and integrity
•    Continue to grow an upbeat, exciting work culture that is both diversified and unique.
•    Proactively looking ahead to identify and provide solutions to issues before they become problems.
•    Any other duty, responsibility, or task assigned by supervisor

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Operations Supervisor to join our team at National Oilwell Varco, L.P. In this role, you will oversee and coordinate the maintenance and restoration of rented equipment, while also managing a team of field operators and technicians. Your primary focus will be to ensure that our equipment is well-maintained and that our customers receive the highest quality service.
- High School Diploma or GED is required.
- A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in solids control equipment is essential.
- Excellent English language skills, both written and verbal.
- Proven ability to assign and review daily tasks effectively.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
- Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time.

- Maintain regular communication with customer representatives to address any concerns and ensure satisfaction.
- Oversee the training and career development of operators and technicians.
- Ensure accurate invoicing and billing processes.
- Communicate upcoming work to shop personnel.
- Actively engage with customers to provide exceptional customer service.

This role is responsible for coordinating daily operations, driving operational excellence, and delivering exceptional customer service.
